 And after 4 years and thousands of dollars spent I finally have a trading bot that works. And not only did it bring me back from the dead on this prop firm challenge. Fuck it, just watch the video. 9 setups an AI copilot took on a micro NASDAQ evaluation account. Loss is included. The rules. Wait for the 15 minute bar to close. Read the structure. Enter on a retest. Stop beyond the swing. Journal everything. September 22nd. A double click turned a two lot short into 4. Closed flat minus 13. Lesson one click. September 28th. A one lot short whose exit was never recorded so no result is shown. October 5th. A short after a bearish bar close trailed a bit tight plus 3450. A second short in the same zone. The stop sat just above the high and got swept minus 131. Then structure flipped up. A lawn on a pullback that held hit its target plus 11550. October 6th. The retest never came. No fill. No chase. October 7th. A lawn on the retest but the trail was too tight plus 650. That evening a failed high a confirmed close and a retest limit plus 133. October 8th at the cash open. A rejection under a lower high target in four minutes plus 11050. Seven closed trades. Five wins. Two losses plus 256 net. Each mistake became a rule. Evaluation account.
